I don't have access to real-time data, so I can't tell you the current Bitcoin price. 

To find the current price, I'd recommend checking:

- **CoinMarketCap.com** or **CoinGecko.com** - comprehensive crypto tracking sites
- **Major exchanges** - Coinbase, Kraken, Binance, etc.
- **Financial websites** - Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, CNBC
- **Your banking app** - if it offers crypto tracking

Bitcoin prices fluctuate constantly, so these sources will give you up-to-the-minute information.
